title: Peanut Butter Banana Pancakes
subtitle: Cookbook Special • Low Calorie • Meal Prep Friendly
description: Delicious, high-protein peanut butter banana pancakes auntie's pancakes, but almost all booty-building protein! light, slightly sweet, and the ultimate post-workout plate. roll, fold, top, and stack, sister! prep: 15 mins total: 15 mins 1 serving v, gf, df*, pp calories lqq2ing: protein carbs fat fibre 36 g 29 g ingredients 250g egg whites (8) 50g fat-free cottage cheese 1 pinch salt 1 tsp vanilla essence 3g powdered sweetener* spray & cook instructions 50g banana iog honey iog almond/peanut butter i tsp cinnamon 1. add the egg whites, cottage cheese, salt, sweetener, and vanilla essence to a blender. blend on high speed until smooth. 2. heat a non-stick pan and spray with cooking spray. 3. pour a thin layer of the batter into medium-sized pancakes, cooking until bubbles form, then flip to cook the other side. 4. repeat until all batter is used, making 5-6 pancakes. 5. roll the pancakes and place on a plate. 6. mix peanut butter with the honey and pop it into the microwave to melt. 7.top the pancakes with sliced banana, sprinkle with cinnamon, and drizzle with the melted peanut butter and honey mixture. enjoy! pro use a pan of spray & cook in pancake for easy flipping/ no'es. meal prep friendly x freezer friendly x from the healthy recipe collection.

instructions.text: 50g Banana IOg Honey IOg Almond/Peanut Butter I Tsp Cinnamon
Add the egg whites, cottage cheese, salt, sweetener, and vanilla essence to a blender. Blend on high speed until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan and spray with cooking spray.
Pour a thin layer of the batter into medium-sized pancakes, cooking until bubbles form, then flip to cook the other side.
Repeat until all batter is used, making 5-6 pancakes.
Roll the pancakes and place on a plate.
Mix peanut butter with the honey and pop it into the microwave to melt.

Top the pancakes with sliced banana, sprinkle with cinnamon, and drizzle with the melted peanut butter and honey mixture. Enjoy! Pro use a pan Of spray & cook in pancake for easy flipping/ No'es. Meal Prep Friendly x Freezer Friendly X
